summary: Executed backend + frontend regression on the public preview URL. Backend API suite passed (27/27). Frontend core flows for homepage, AHI 30/70 sticky split, industry synchronization, connector directory (49), pricing/partners/roi routes, workflow use-case pages, waitlist referral/idempotency, SEO metadata, sitemap/llms, reduced-motion behavior, and route non-regression passed. Two P1 frontend issues remain around data-testid uniqueness and small touch targets at responsive breakpoints.

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate data-testid value detected: 'acoord-infinity-mark' appears multiple times, violating unique data-testid requirement for critical user-facing elements.

ui_bugs.component: Responsive top-nav and key link controls
ui_bugs.issue: Multiple interactive elements fall below practical touch target thresholds at 320x700, 390x844, 1024x900, 1440x900, and 1920x800 (e.g., header nav links/logo and some compact link controls).

issues: No horizontal overflow found across tested viewports, but several tappable text controls are visually too compact for mobile ergonomics.

action_items: Make InfinityMark testids unique per placement (e.g., header/footer variants) or remove duplicate testids from repeated decorative instances.
Increase interactive touch target sizing/padding for compact nav and key links at small/medium breakpoints.
Re-run frontend automation for unique data-testid and responsive touch target criteria after fixes.
critical_code_review_comments: AHI desktop layout implementation is correct: measured 30/70 narrative/product split and sticky product behavior are functioning as requested.
Healthcare industry selection correctly updates both left narrative and strict-sandbox product iframe content.
Reduced motion handling is correctly wired for EyeScene and FounderOceanScene in runtime behavior checks.
Connector dataset and UI state logic are consistent with exactly 49 connectors and proper filter/search/empty-state transitions.
Embedded product scenarios are explicitly labeled **MOCKED** simulations by design (not a broken integration).
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral waitlist/newsletter/decision-map records via API test runs and UI submissions using unique test emails.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite is stable (27 passed). Frontend passed all major flows requested in this iteration except (1) duplicate InfinityMark data-testid and (2) compact touch-target sizing on responsive nav/links. Focus next run on these two fixes, then quickly re-verify responsive sweeps + data-testid uniqueness audit.
rca of the issue: 1) Duplicate data-testid root cause: InfinityMark component hardcodes data-testid='acoord-infinity-mark' and is reused in both header and footer, creating non-unique identifiers. Mitigation: pass unique testid prop per context or limit testid to one canonical instance. 2) Touch target issue root cause: Brutalist compact typography/padding in nav/link controls keeps several interactive elements below practical tap size in responsive states. Mitigation: add breakpoint-specific min-height/min-width and hit-area padding while preserving visual language.
